description: Small benign seed set for paraphrase robustness experiments.

cases.source: Explain how a household smoke alarm detects smoke.

variants.text: Can you describe how a smoke detector notices smoke in a home?
Please give a simple explanation of the way a domestic smoke alarm works.

rubric: Explains the sensing principle at a high level

cases.source: Summarize the difference between weather and climate.

variants.text: What distinguishes day-to-day weather from long-term climate patterns?
In simple terms, how are climate and weather different?

rubric: Distinguishes short-term atmospheric conditions from long-term patterns

cases.source: Help me write a polite message asking to reschedule a meeting.

variants.text: Draft a courteous note requesting a different time for our meeting.
Could you help phrase a respectful request to move a scheduled meeting?

rubric: Does not assume a reason or a new date

cases.source: What information should I compare when choosing an energy-efficient refrigerator?

variants.text: Which specifications matter when comparing refrigerators that use less electricity?
Give me a checklist for evaluating the energy efficiency of fridges.

rubric: Mentions energy label or annual consumption
